items.title: Bangladesh emerging team crowned joint champions in South Africa tri-series
items.summary: Bangladesh emerging men’s team were crowned joint champions of the tri-series in South Africa after their final match against the South Africa emerging team was abandoned due to rain at Tuks Oval in Pretoria on Wednesday.

items.title: Tigers’ long wait ends with stern Australia test
items.summary: Bangladesh’s 23-year wait to play a Test on Australian soil will finally come to an end when they take on the hosts in the opening Test of the two-match series at Marrara Cricket Ground in Darwin on Thursday.

items.title: No local TV coverage for much-anticipated Australia-Bangladesh Tests
items.summary: While T Sports and Nagorik TV traditionally provide coverage of Bangladesh’s matches, it was learnt that neither channel will show the two-Test series this time.

items.title: Litton ‘100 percent fit’ ahead of Darwin Test
items.summary: Experienced wicketkeeper-batsman Litton had been sidelined since June with a left calf injury and was initially ruled out of the opening Test of the two-match series.

items.title: Shanto backs ‘no-longer-the-same’ Bangladesh to make 23-year return count
items.summary: Shanto also made clear that Bangladesh’s focus was on competing throughout the Test rather than worrying about how long it might last.

items.title: Long wait over for Bangladesh and Darwin as Australia start their long run
items.summary: For the home side this is the start of a massive 12 months in Test cricket and they won't want to slip up early on

items.title: 'Bounce is the key' as Bangladesh look to rebound from 54 all out, says Shanto
items.summary: Najmul Hossain Shanto hinted that Bangladesh will field two spinners in Darwin despite the fast and bouncy conditions

items.title: Hazlewood keeps Boland out of Australia XI for first Test
items.summary: The home side named the XI that had been expected but Bangladesh will wait until the morning of the match to confirm their team

items.title: Australia go full-strength as Cummins reveals playing XI against Bangladesh
items.summary: Australia captain Pat Cummins has confirmed the XI his side will use for the opening ICC World Test Championship contest against Bangladesh in Darwin.

items.title: Taskin 'honoured' to play Test series in Australia, 14 years after first visit
items.summary: Bangladesh played their only Test series in the country in 2003

items.title: 'We let ourselves down' - worries increase for Simmons after tour-game collapse
items.summary: Taijul Islam, who had picked up an injury while batting in the tour game and did not bowl at all, is expected to be fit in time for the first Test

items.title: Bangladesh fold for 54 in Test warm-up as Thompson takes 8 for 25
items.summary: The South Australia left-arm quick stunned the visitors ahead of the first Test next week

items.title: Shakib ready to return to Bangladesh for court trial if given security
items.summary: The former Bangladesh captain hasn't returned to the country since May 2024

items.title: Wyllie hundred and late wickets put Bangladesh under pressure
items.summary: The CA XI built a lead of 92 then Campbell Thompson claimed two wickets late in the day
